plugin.name: Settings Migrate
plugin.author: Envesko
plugin.description: Export a UserSpice site's configuration - settings, permissions, page guards, and plugin enable-states - to a single JSON bundle, then import it on another install. Secrets (API keys, SMTP passwords, tokens) are redacted by default. Import runs a dry-run diff first so you see exactly what will change before applying. Other plugins can contribute their own portable config by shipping a migrate_export.php file. Built to make moving a site between dev, staging, and production painless.
